title: Kara Ahmed Pasha Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: The named mosque and madrasa enclosure polygon identifies the existing building.

terrainReference.basis: Independently sampled courtyard ground immediately in front of the portico.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap relation, aligned with the original historical plan.
mapIdentity.scope: The named native OpenStreetMap multipolygon fixes the mosque and court. The 1912 measured plan records the orthogonal prayer room, supporting half-domes, porch and roofline. The Istanbul survey describes a 12 m main interior dome.

note: The exact Qualla architectural plate gives the drum, window bands, roof curvature and wall proportions. Architectural records describe the five-domed porch, cut limestone walls, flanking madrasa wings and single-balcony minaret.
